name: Manastej Redesign
summary: A motion-rich website redesign concept for Manastej, with responsive layouts and scroll-driven storytelling.
overview: An unofficial redesign concept built with Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP ScrollTrigger, and Lenis. It explores a mental wellness platform's visual presentation through horizontal feature panels, botanical artwork, and layered typography. The Manastej name, logo, and original copy belong to Manastej; this is a design concept, not a commissioned product or a working care service.
highlights: Scroll-driven horizontal feature panels and depth parallax
Responsive sections with reduced-motion alternatives
Reusable motion helpers scoped to each section
Desktop, mobile, and reduced-motion screenshots in the repository

name: ClearStudy
summary: A browser-local revision workspace with priority-based study plans, recall practice, a focus timer, and validated backups.
overview: A dependency-free HTML, CSS, and JavaScript study workspace that stores plans, notes, and recall history locally in the browser. Study time is allocated using explicit importance and confidence scores, and review intervals follow deterministic rules. It supports editable question banks, CSV import, offline caching, and JSON backup restoration. A hosted demo is available; real-user evaluation is still pending, and no educational outcome claims are made.
highlights: Study plans that allocate the exact requested whole-minute budget
Editable question bank with CSV import and duplicate detection
Self-rated recall, due-review queues, and a persistent focus timer
Validated JSON backups and stale-tab save conflict detection

name: HomeRelay
summary: A household task board where ownership changes only after an accepted handoff, with persistent history and six MCP tools.
overview: A functioning trusted-household prototype built with FastAPI, SQLite, and a browser interface. Tasks retain their current owner while a handoff is pending, and only the selected recipient can accept or decline. REST and Streamable HTTP MCP expose the same stored workflow with version checks for stale changes. It has no individual account isolation or publicly hosted application, and is presented as a local prototype rather than a production household service.
highlights: Explicit propose, accept, decline, and complete task transitions
SQLite persistence and ordered task history
Version checks and request IDs for stale updates and duplicate retries
Six Streamable HTTP MCP tools backed by stored task data

name: LiveVolume
summary: Spatial video calling that reconstructs callers as interactive 3D point clouds on Android.
overview: Built for the iQOO Hackathon, LiveVolume combines on-device depth estimation, foreground segmentation, and OpenGL rendering to explore volumetric calling on consumer mobile hardware.
highlights: MiDaS depth estimation and MediaPipe foreground segmentation
Touch-controlled 3D point clouds with a 2D / 3D call toggle
Agora audio, video, and chunked point-cloud transport
Firebase call invitations and incoming-call notifications

name: Synapse ERP
summary: Converts handwritten ledgers, product photos, and informal orders into structured business records.
overview: A multimodal OCR and deep-learning project for Indian MSMEs. A Next.js conversion desk and FastAPI backend turn existing offline records into inventory, customer records, invoices, and analytics. The repository distinguishes implemented workflows from model scaffolds and planned training.
highlights: Handwritten ledger OCR architecture and training scaffold
Product recognition and code-mixed order extraction scaffolds
Structured inventory, CRM, invoice, and analytics output
Demand forecasting training script and background conversion jobs

name: Quantum Phase Oracle
summary: A three-qubit Deutsch–Jozsa phase oracle for a balanced parity function, with its output distribution.
overview: A focused quantum computing experiment that implements a balanced three-input Boolean function as a phase oracle. It documents the circuit's state transitions and computes the probability distribution over all eight output states.
highlights: Balanced three-bit parity function
Hadamard–oracle–Hadamard circuit
Documented state evolution and output probabilities

name: Crop Disease Concept Net
summary: An interpretable crop disease model that connects leaf images to six visible symptom concepts.
overview: Transfer learning with a Concept Bottleneck Network: a pretrained ResNet18 feeds a six-symptom concept layer and a 14-class disease head. Training and prediction scripts support the crop disease dataset and synthetic demo data.
highlights: ResNet18 → symptom concepts → disease classification
Six concepts including rust patches, yellowing, and healthy tissue
Dataset split variants and a two-class comparison
Training, prediction, and synthetic demo-data scripts

name: Singlepass Studio
summary: A drone reconstruction operator interface with a point-cloud viewer and observability shading.
overview: An operator interface wireframe for single-pass drone 3D reconstruction, built around a brass-on-graphite visual system. The associated feasibility harness explores GPU capacity, metric scale, parallax, and scene visibility against synthetic ground truth.
highlights: Point-cloud inspection and observability shading
Operator interface for a single-pass reconstruction workflow
Associated synthetic-scene feasibility experiments

name: SwiftBus
summary: A bus booking capstone with search, seat selection, bookings, and multilingual travel flows.
overview: A RedBus-inspired full-stack capstone for the Internshala website-building track. The repository covers the traveller journey, community features, notifications, route planning, reviews, and English, Tamil, and Hindi interfaces. Payments use a stub.
highlights: Search, seat selection, booking, and cancellation
Supabase authentication, data, and realtime services
Maps, route planning, and notification workflows
English, Tamil, and Hindi with persisted dark mode

name: ReliefStream
summary: Centralizes flood rescue requests with AI extraction, deduplication, a map, and volunteer coordination.
overview: A flood rescue coordination MVP for Code for Communities 2026. It turns scattered social-media text into prioritized requests and keeps ambiguous model output visible for a human operator to review.
highlights: Structured location, urgency, and request-type extraction
Duplicate request grouping and severity-coded map pins
Volunteer assignment, resolution, and outcome logs
A human-review queue for ambiguous requests

name: Phalanx
summary: A HackFusion concept for multi-persona agents that audit application flows, security, and usability.
overview: A HackFusion 2026 Round 1 concept for autonomous QA. The proposed architecture combines simultaneous synthetic users, code-aware persona generation, and reproducible Playwright findings. Presented as a concept rather than a production service.
highlights: Proposed multi-persona browser sessions
Cross-user permission and concurrency scenarios
Code-aware persona generation
Reproducible findings with Playwright scripts
